marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 15 knots increasing to southeast 20 early Tuesday
morning and to southeast 30 near noon Tuesday. Scattered flurries Tuesday. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Tuesday.
marine.text: Seas 1 metre or less building to 2 Tuesday evening.<br/>
